description:
Planning application:
Removal of greenhouse, barn and portable buildings at West end of site and erection of part single, two and three storey primary and nursery school with associated facilities and hardstanding including multi use games area on field to North, formation of pedestrian access and a vehicular access on to Norwood Green Road, formation, alterations and formation of pedestrian and vehicular routes and provision of 74 car parking spaces, including 5 disabled, for the proposed school and Norwood Hall and internal and external alterations and erection of ramped access to North elevation and an external staircase to Norwood Hall in conjunction with its use as an Adult Education and Community Centre.

Listed Building consent:
Internal and external alterations to Norwood Hall and attached conservatory, including the removal of two existing external staircases and erection of one replacement external staircase and ramped access to North elevation entrance, works to walled garden including landscaping, removal of greenhouses and works to walls, works within garden including the removal of outbuildings, greenhouses and strutures in conjunction with the formation of parking areas, pedestrian and vehicular routes and accesses and the erection of a part single, two and three storey 2 form entry primary and nursery school and use of Norwood Hall as an Adult Education and Community Centre.
